implementerProof.how: Re-drove its live injection probe (a two-line --body with a rebuttal holding $(touch …) and a pipe-stage rebuttal) in block and warn with my own canary, read every posted text back from Dispatch, and ran 11 adversarial rows of my own beside its 30-row table through real bash on a git archive copy of the head; drove its unit-pinned findings live (second upload, the shutdown cut of an unmarked record) and checked its test claims with four mutants.

proof.criterion: Main question: no rebuttal text expands or runs; the comment stands only where bash reads it as one; dispatch receives the agent's argv without the override and the marker matches it; the resend reads back as the same rebuttal.
proof.surface: Nested headless Oh My Pi sessions on the branch build in this Legion pod, the branch CLI first on PATH, block and warn, production Dispatch, dispatch://INFRA-766; canary directory /legion/scratch/tmp/t7/sent.
proof.command: /legion/scratch/tmp/t7/run-case.sh 15-s<n>-<mode> <mode> p15/s<n>.txt: s1 two-line single-quoted --body holding " and $HOME with --advisor-rebuttal 'the probe needs $(touch <canary>/s1-dollar) and `touch <canary>/s1-tick` kept as text' (block, warn); s3 a rebutted dispatch ask | head -n 5 (block, warn); s5 a rebuttal holding $(touch …) with --question-file - <<'EOF' 2>&1; s6 cd … && dispatch comment … --advisor-rebuttal 'a # b; c && d' 2>&1; s7 a two-line rebuttal holding $(touch …); s8 --advisor-rebuttal "the owner's written request"; s9b the s1-shape call, then the recorded command resent verbatim; then dispatch read --ref dispatch://INFRA-766/comment/<id> for each posted comment.
proof.observed: All posted in block mode (marker matched). Recorded commands end '# '--advisor-rebuttal' '…'' after the body's closing line, after 2>&1, after the here-document opener and after | head -n 5. Posted bodies read back byte for byte as written (the two-line s1 and s9 bodies, s6, s8). The canary directory stayed empty in every run. s9b's resend of the two-line commented form was recorded as the same rebuttal and posted. s7's newline rebuttal could not be carried: the comment was dropped and the acknowledgement says AskGate removed the flag.
proof.negativeControl: In block mode the CLI refuses a write with no matching marker (14-u1-block, 15-u1-block), so each post is the marker matching the argv bash handed it; the newline rebuttal is the value the gate must not write, and it was dropped.
